{{Quote|I... ''had'' them, Lord Vader! Luke Skywalker... Leia Organa... I ''captured'' them!"<br />"True... I did not expect you to be so efficient. But you did lose them immediately afterwards. That I ''expected.''|Ryko Vant and Darth Vader|<ref name="dkd" />}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Ryko Vant''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jerne]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The commander of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] at [[Jerne City H.Q.]], Vant at one point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] managed to [[Mission to Jerne|capture]] major [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leaders [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], but was assaulted by guerrillas led by [[Meeka Reen]] before he could take them into custody.<ref name="dkd" />

Vant fled in terror back to Jerne City on a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] as his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were slaughtered, where he was confronted by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who had come to Jerne to spring a trap of his own&mdash;he intended to lure Skywalker and Organa into an ambush at [[Adony Station]] with rumors of a powerful artifact called the "[[Eternity Crystal]]." Vant accompanied Vader to Adony Station to watch the Rebels' demise, but Skywalker turned the tables and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Vant with a [[Proton grenade/Legends|proton grenade]].<ref name="dkd" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ryko Vant first appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] "[[Dark Knight's Devilry]]," which was written by [[Steve Moore]], illustrated by [[Alan Davis]], and first published in the [[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 153|''The Empire Strikes Back Monthly'' 153]]<ref name="dkd" /> in [[January]] [[1982]].<ref name="Epic">''[[Star Wars Legends Epic Collection: The Original Marvel Years Vol. 3]]''</ref>
